representation: Concept B: two explicit comparisons; no ruler, axis, filled band or shaded interval
review_role: Chief Medical Officer agent; clinical evidence/source review, not human clinician approval
scope: Read-only clinical review of the final comparison-based source. The prior neutral number-line preflight was superseded after image-only readers still inferred a desirable interval. Rendered legibility and comprehension remain with the independent judge.

clinical_facts.independent_example: hs-CRP 3.2 mg/L, labelled Example/Ejemplo, independent of Alex’s unchanged 2.1 mg/L case.
clinical_facts.lab_comparison: 3.2 < 5 mg/L: below this illustrative adult assay reference limit. It is not proof of optimal health; laboratory limits vary.
clinical_facts.review_comparison: 3.2 > 2 mg/L, if persistent: above the European ESC/EAS 2025 risk-review modifier. Persistence is a condition of interpretation, not an assumed property of this single example.
clinical_facts.action: Repeat when well; if still elevated, review overall cardiovascular risk. This is educational next-step wording, without a fixed repeat interval, diagnosis or treatment direction.

source_design_check.no_implied_interval: Approved at source level: no continuous ruler, risk zone, overlap window, safe band or optimal band is drawn.
source_design_check.same_sample: Approved: both rows explicitly compare the same 3.2 mg/L example with different clinically sourced cutoffs.
source_design_check.persistence: Approved: the >2 comparison has an adjacent if persistent/si persiste condition, and the action explains confirming persistence when well.
source_design_check.reference_scope: Approved: the first verdict says below this lab’s reference limit rather than universally healthy or optimal.
source_design_check.context: Visible laboratory-variation and no-diagnosis notes remain. Native details explain health history, other risk factors, acute inflammatory causes and clinical stability.
source_design_check.no_extra_paragraph: No additional clinical paragraph is required for this scoped educational example.
source_design_check.accessible_description: Approved: the description distinguishes the laboratory limit from conditional review and explicitly excludes an optimal target or diagnosis.

wording_checked.en: Above 2 mg/L? Repeat when well. If still raised, review overall heart risk.
wording_checked.es: ¿Más de 2 mg/L? Repite cuando estés bien. Si sigue elevado, valora el riesgo cardiovascular global.

continuing_restrictions: Do not restore a desirable/safe/optimal band above or below 2.
Do not say this sample will cause or inevitably lead to disease.
Do not turn the review modifier into an individualized disease forecast, automatic treatment or universal repeat interval.

sources.title: CDC/Roche hs-CRP laboratory manual 2021–2023
sources.location: Section 13, PDF page 18: documented adult reference <5 mg/L.

sources.title: 2025 ESC/EAS dyslipidaemia focused update
sources.location: Box 1, risk modifiers beyond SCORE2/SCORE2-OP: persistently elevated hs-CRP >2 mg/L.

sources.title: ERFC/Lancet prospective meta-analysis
sources.location: 160,309 participants from 54 prospective studies support association with later cardiovascular events, not personalized prediction.
